entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu And Kashmir
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Instant application seeking extension of time for annexing/depositing the requisite court fee with the petition, in view of the grounds urged therein, is allowed.

The petitioner shall deposit the requisite court fee with the Registry of this Court within a period of one week from the date of pronouncement of lifting of lockdown on account of COVID-19 by the Government.

Through the medium of instant petition, the petitioners have challenged FIR No.237/2020 for offences under Section 272, 273, 328, 420, 120-B of IPC, Section 7/16 of Food Safety Act and Section 3/7 of Essential Commodities Act registered with Police Station, Bari Brahmana.

It is the case of the petitioners that the offences stated in the FIR are not made out from a bare reading of the contents of the said FIR, inasmuch as the petitioners are duly licensed and authorized to manufacture, re-pack and re-label Mustard oil and Soyabean oil.

In this regard the petitioners Mohit Gupta And Another vs Union Territory Of J&K on 27 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82226384/
1 have placed on record copy of the licenses issued by the competent authority.

entities.text: Mohit Gupta And Another vs Union Territory Of J&K
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the further case of the petitioners that during investigation of the case, the reports of the Food Analyst pertaining to the samples of Soyabean oil and Mustard oil seized from the factory of the petitioners have been found to be conforming to the standards.
Copies of said reports have been placed on record.
Having regard to the arguments of learned counsel for the petitioners and having considered the documents placed on record, a case for grant of interim indulgence is made out.
Issue notice to the respondent through Mr. Aijaz Lone, Dy. AG.
Learned counsel for the petitioner shall furnish soft copy of the paper book to Mr. Aijaz Lone, Dy. AG, who may file response thereto by or before the next date of hearing.
Meanwhile, subject to objections and till next date of hearing, investigation in the impugned FIR shall stay.
